jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.support: Right-click to hang the carcass. Leave air below.
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.bleed_tool: Right-click the hanging carcass. A blood grate below collects the blood.
jei.winterheart_butchery.step.head: Head
jei.winterheart_butchery.tray: Butcher it on a metal tray
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.repair: Right-click the golem corpse with %s, one at a time
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.skin: Right-click an empty skin rack with it
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.wetter: Right-click the salted skin with it, wet. Wet it on water or a full cauldron.
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.leather: Right-click the rack to take it
jei.winterheart_butchery.skull.how: Right-click a placed head with a hammer
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.head: Place it as a block
jei.winterheart_butchery.acid.how: Right-click an uncut carcass with acid
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.uncut: Placed, with nothing cut off yet
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.returned: You get the empty bottle back
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.salt_water: Right-click an empty basin with it. You get the bucket back.
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.salt_take: Once the water is gone, right-click the basin for one at a time
jei.winterheart_butchery.blood.how: Hang over a grate, bleed with a cleaver
jei.winterheart_butchery.blood.small.tip: 250 mB, under a bottle. Grate reach %2$s blocks (%1$s if instant):
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.bleed_carca: One carcass fills the grate with this much
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.bottle: Right-click the grate; each takes %s mB
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.bleed_cleav: Right-click the hanging carcass with a cleaver
jei.winterheart_butchery.bonemeal.sculk: Used up even when it fails
jei.winterheart_butchery.bonemeal.wither: On the top half. Failing destroys the bush
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.bonemeal.wi: Right-click the top half of a placed rose bush
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.dry: Hold it in the main hand
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.water: Right-click a water source or a water cauldron
jei.winterheart_butchery.tip.phantom: Phantoms reach only %s, unless bleeding is instant
